bc011.title: The application restarts and file rotation continues.
bc011.requiredResult: Instance identity changes, existing owned segments are handled consistently, retention is bounded, and unrelated files survive.
bc011.originalRequiredResult: Instance identity changes, existing owned segments are handled consistently, retention is bounded, and unrelated files survive.
bc011.boundary: Physical per-process file writer/retention fixture with injected metadata; full public candidate-runtime restart remains T02. Business assertions verify changed record-level instance IDs, stable group, bounded retained count and neighbor preservation. Cross-restart segment continuity/ordering/recovery is supplied by the linked executed FileRetentionProcessTests.SeparateProducersKeepTheSameGroupAndNewestBoundedSegments and FileRestartProcessTests.SeparateProducerAndRestartProcessesPreserveWholeSegmentsAndSafeFailures, rather than a separate business-level inventory comparison.

recordingPlan: After evidence review returns, retain its raw result, update review.final to actual verdict, update task status if PASS and freeze a checksum inventory before commit. No final-review PASS is pre-written.
